dict.string: Notch Island reads what Music and Spotify are playing so it can show it in the island and control playback.
Notch Island shows your next calendar event as a Live Activity in the island.
Notch Island shows AirPods and other Bluetooth devices when they connect, with their battery level.
Notch Island only checks whether the microphone is in use to show the privacy indicator. It never records audio.
Notch Island uses your approximate location for the Weather tab. It is never stored or shared.
Notch Island listens to the system's audio level only to animate the Now Playing bars. Nothing is recorded.
Notch Island shows a live mirror in the Home panel when you open the Mirror tab, so you can check yourself before a call. The privacy indicator itself never captures video.
